gtf.title: GTF Annotation
gtf.description: Gene annotation GTF. Must be well-formed: each transcript needs a 'transcript' row before its 'exon' rows.

cellrangerarc_version.title: Cell Ranger ARC Version
cellrangerarc_version.description: Cell Ranger ARC version (appended to the quay.io/cumulus/cellranger-arc image tag). Proprietary 10X Genomics software.

cellrangerarc_reference_name.title: Reference Name
cellrangerarc_reference_name.description: Name of the output reference directory.

cellrangerarc_motifs.title: ATAC Motifs (optional)
cellrangerarc_motifs.description: ATAC transcription-factor motifs file in JASPAR format (optional). Leave unset to build the reference without motif annotation.

cellrangerarc_mkref_args.title: mkref Extra Arguments
cellrangerarc_mkref_args.description: Additional arguments to pass to cellranger-arc mkref.
